key_insight: BW-FISTA lifts suitable Gaussian Bures–Wasserstein optimization problems into Euclidean affine transport maps, achieving a minimax-optimal O(k⁻²) objective gap.
engineering_relevance: For Gaussian variational inference with log-concave, log-smooth targets, the method improves the theoretical convergence rate from O(k⁻¹) to O(k⁻²).
method: Lift Gaussian-measure optimization into Euclidean affine transport coordinates.
Apply accelerated proximal gradients when the lifts are convex, smooth, and proximable as required.
Handle the variational-inference entropy term with an efficient, exact proximal step.
evidence_signal: Synthetic experiments numerically verify the predicted acceleration; the abstract reports no real-world benchmarks.
watch_item: The guarantee requires suitable convex affine lifts and smoothness/proximability conditions, so it does not automatically extend to arbitrary targets or objectives.
paper_title: An Accelerated Proximal Gradient Method for Bures-Wasserstein Space
